message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta. In most U.S. cities, including Atlanta, noise complaints are handled by the city’s **Police Department** or the **Code Enforcement** office rather than the city council itself. Here’s how you can do it:

| Step | What to Do | Where/How |
|------|------------|-----------|
| 1 | **Gather Details** | Note the time, date, location, and description of the noise (e.g., loud music, construction, barking dogs). If possible, record a short audio clip or take photos. |
| 2 | **File Online** | Visit the City of Atlanta’s official website: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/>. Search for “Noise Complaint” or “Code Enforcement.” Many cities offer an online form or portal for filing complaints. |
| 3 | **Call the Police** | Dial 911 for emergencies. For non‑emergency noise complaints, call the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line at **404‑656‑4000**. |
| 4 | **Visit the Police Station** | If you prefer in person, go to the nearest Atlanta Police Department precinct. Bring your documentation and any evidence. |
| 5 | **Follow Up** | After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. Keep it handy for follow‑up calls or emails. |

### Quick Contact Info

| Agency | Phone | Email | Website |
|--------|-------|-------|---------|
| Atlanta Police Department – Non‑Emergency | 404‑656‑4000 | (Use the online form on the city website) | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/police> |
| City of Atlanta Code Enforcement | 404‑656‑4000 (same as police) | (Same as above) | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/government/departments/code-enforcement> |

### Tips

- **Non‑Emergency Line**: Use the non‑emergency line for routine complaints. 911 is strictly for emergencies (fires, crimes in progress, etc.).
- **Documentation Helps**: The more evidence you provide (photos, videos, timestamps), the easier it is for officials to investigate.
- **Check Ordinances**: Noise ordinances vary by neighborhood. The city website often lists the specific rules for each zone.

If you’re unsure whether a particular noise violates city ordinances, you can also call the city’s general information line at **404‑656‑4000** and ask for guidance.
